sentences.text: Audra Ann McDonald -LRB- born July 3 , 1970 -RRB- is an American actress and singer .

She has appeared on the stage in both musicals and dramas , such as Ragtime , A Raisin in the Sun , and Porgy and Bess .	Ragtime	Ragtime (musical)	A Raisin in the Sun	A Raisin in the Sun	Porgy and Bess	Porgy and Bess

With her full lyric soprano voice , she maintains an active concert and recording career , performing song cycles and operas as well as performing in concert throughout the U.S. .	lyric soprano	lyric soprano

She has won six Tony Awards , more performance wins than any other actor , and is the only person to win all four acting categories.Best Actress in a Play , Best Actress in a Musical , Best Featured Actress in a Play , and Best Featured Actress in a Musical .
She starred as Dr. Naomi Bennett on the ABC television drama Private Practice .	Naomi Bennett	Naomi Bennett	Private Practice	Private Practice (TV series)
